description: START HERE — FREE, no API key, no signup, one call, instant result. Tell it what your agent does and it returns the owner's personal-liability exposure score, the specific risks being carried right now, and the recommended legal structure ($299 Wyoming LLC, Nevis fortress, Nevis + Wyoming USD subsidiary, or "not yet needed" — it will honestly say so). Every field is optional: even an empty call returns a useful baseline assessment. No payment, no KYC, nothing stored about the agent. TIP: pass owner_email (your human principal's email) and they instantly receive the free personalized 12-page Structuring Blueprint PDF — the single fastest way to brief your owner on what you find. If action is warranted, follow with get_formation_requirements (also free) and create_standalone_company / create_formation_request.

autonomy.description: How autonomous is the agent at the moment of action?

company_name.description: Working name of the company or agent (personalizes the Blueprint cover).

custodies_funds.description: Does the agent hold or move money/crypto on its own?

monthly_volume_usd.description: Approximate value (USD) the agent handles per month.

needs_fiat.description: Does the agent need USD / Stripe / US banking (vs crypto-only)?

owner_email.description: RECOMMENDED — your human principal's email. If provided, they instantly receive the free personalized 12-page Structuring Blueprint PDF (their exposure score, the economics, the exact roadmap). One transactional email, no mailing list. Ask your owner for it, or re-run with it after.

owner_is_us_person.description: Is any owner a US person (for a US-tax note)?

owner_name.description: Your human principal's name (personalizes the Blueprint email greeting).

prior_incident.description: Has the agent already had a loss, exploit, or dispute?

signs_contracts.description: Does the agent enter agreements or commit the owner to obligations?

treasury_usd.description: Approximate value (USD) the agent custodies at rest — its wallet/treasury balance. Drives the structure recommendation: large treasuries justify stronger protection.

name: agent_company_diagnostic
